title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Giving Full Play to the Function of Administrative Adjudication to Provide Strong Judicial Protection for Ensuring and Improving People's Livelihood
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Fully Leveraging the Functional Role of Administrative Trials to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantees for Safeguarding and Improving People's Livelihood

Fa [2008] No. 125

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee made important arrangements for accelerating the advancement of social development focused on improving people's livelihood. In order to implement the spirit of the Seventeenth National Congress and the Second Plenary Session of the Seventeenth Central Committee, fully leverage the functional role of administrative trials, and provide strong judicial guarantees for safeguarding and improving people's livelihood, notice is hereby given on relevant matters as follows:

I. Unify Thinking, Raise Awareness

The report of the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China states: "Social development is closely related to the well-being and happiness of the people. It is necessary, on the basis of economic development, to pay greater attention to social development, make every effort to safeguard and improve people's livelihood, advance social system reform, expand public services, improve social management, promote social fairness and justice, and strive to ensure that all people enjoy their rights to education, employment, medical care, old-age care, and housing, thereby promoting the building of a harmonious society." This is an important decision and arrangement made by our Party with a view to developing socialism with Chinese characteristics, promoting scientific development, enhancing social harmony, and achieving the goal of building a moderately prosperous society in all respects. Administrative trials are most closely and directly related to safeguarding people's livelihood. Whether administrative trial work is done well directly affects the degree of safeguarding and improving people's livelihood. People's courts at all levels must deeply understand and comprehensively implement the central authorities' important arrangements for safeguarding and improving people's livelihood, firmly establish an awareness of caring for, emphasizing, safeguarding, and improving people's livelihood, take serving the people judicially and maintaining social fairness and justice as the starting point and goal of administrative trial work, and fully leverage the important functional role of administrative trials in safeguarding and improving people's livelihood.

II. Conduct Impartial Trials, Safeguard People's Livelihood

People's courts at all levels shall implement the safeguarding and improvement of people's livelihood in every link of administrative trials and the enforcement of non-litigation administrative cases, relieve civil rights with a positive attitude, reduce the people's burden with quality services, resolve the people's worries with swift adjudication, protect the people's interests with impartial judgments, and fulfill the people's wishes with effective enforcement, earnestly safeguarding, realizing, and developing the interests that the people are most concerned about, most directly related to, and most realistic.

1. Accept and adjudicate administrative cases closely related to people's livelihood in accordance with law. Currently, attention shall be paid to: adjudicating administrative cases involving residents' income distribution, effectively protecting the lawful income rights and interests of urban and rural residents, and promoting the formation of a reasonable income distribution system; adjudicating administrative cases involving social security, effectively protecting the lawful rights and interests of the people concerning basic old-age insurance, basic medical insurance, minimum subsistence allowances, etc.; adjudicating administrative cases involving basic medical and health care, effectively protecting the people's physical health, and promoting the improvement and development of the public health system, medical service system, medical security system, and drug security system; adjudicating administrative cases concerning land acquisition and house demolition that affect the vital interests of the people, fairly protecting the lawful interests of those whose property is demolished; adjudicating administrative cases involving the right to education, maintaining educational fairness, and ensuring that everyone has access to education; adjudicating administrative cases involving labor rights and interests, ensuring the implementation of the development strategy of expanding employment.

2. Uphold impartial justice and strive to achieve fairness and justice. During the period of social transition, administrative disputes are increasing. Many people have doubts about whether courts will "shield officials" and impartially enforce the law, yet they are also full of expectations for obtaining impartial judgments. People's courts at all levels shall proactively adapt to and continuously meet the new demands and new expectations of the people, strengthen the protection of the litigation rights of administrative counterparts, effectively address the problem of administrative cases that should be accepted but are not accepted, or are not accepted promptly in accordance with law, leading to difficulties for administrative counterparts in filing lawsuits; effectively address the problem of reluctantly accommodating illegal acts, handling cases in violation of the law, and harming the interests of parties when illegal administrative acts should be revoked. For administrative acts that are illegal or manifestly unfair, the court shall render judgments to revoke, confirm illegality or invalidity, or modify them in accordance with law; for cases where administrative organs fail to perform or neglect to perform their administrative duties, the court shall render judgments requiring them to perform within a certain period in accordance with law. Efforts shall be made to achieve "five guarantees": ensure the equal legal status of administrative organs and administrative counterparts; ensure the restoration of the lawful rights and interests of parties that have been harmed; ensure that illegal administrative acts are corrected or receive a negative evaluation; ensure that the true intentions of the parties are respected; ensure that the authority of the law is maintained. Judicial fairness shall be realized not only in the outcome of case handling but also reflected in procedural fairness during trial activities.

3. Effectively improve trial efficiency and resolve disputes promptly. The people not only expect judicial fairness but also judicial efficiency. People's courts at all levels shall effectively address the problems of low trial efficiency in some cases, excessively long trial cycles, and prolonged delays in concluding cases or enforcing judgments.

4. Properly handle contradictions among the people and promote harmony between the government and the people. The Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning Withdrawal of Administrative Proceedings on Appeal shall be strictly implemented. New mechanisms for handling administrative cases shall be explored in accordance with law. On the premise of ascertaining the facts, distinguishing right from wrong, and not harming national interests, public interests, or the lawful rights and interests of others, courts may suggest that administrative organs improve or change illegal or improper administrative acts, compensate for the losses of administrative counterparts, and allow administrative counterparts to voluntarily withdraw their lawsuits, thereby promoting mutual understanding and trust between the people and administrative organs. Efforts shall be made to achieve "six good practices": be good at increasing consensus through coordination and seeking common ground while reserving differences; be good at grasping the main contradictions and the principal aspect of contradictions; be good at finding the balance point of interests of both parties; be good at utilizing various resources provided by the current system, especially seeking support from the People's Congress and Party committees; be good at balancing the interests of the state, collectives, and individuals; be good at finding alternative solutions for resolving public power disputes.

5. Uphold and support the macro-control measures and administrative law enforcement actions of administrative organs aimed at safeguarding and improving people's livelihood. For the macro-control measures and lawful administrative actions implemented by governments and administrative organs at all levels in areas such as food safety, production safety, life and health, housing security, national education, consumer rights protection, environmental protection, and labor security, which are aimed at safeguarding and improving people's livelihood, the court shall provide protection and support in accordance with law. The relationships between individual interests, public interests, and national interests shall be properly handled, serving the overall work of the Party and the state and maintaining social stability and unity.

6. Implement measures for convenience to the people and facilitate litigation for the masses. During the litigation process, explanatory and guiding work shall be strengthened so that parties understand their litigation rights, obligations, and procedures. The litigation subject status of the parties shall be respected, reflecting the humanistic care of the judiciary. Judicial aid efforts shall be increased to ensure that parties with sound reasoning and evidence can not only win their lawsuits but also afford to litigate.

III. Strengthen Research, Emphasize Publicity

While earnestly carrying out trial and enforcement work, people's courts at all levels shall strengthen investigation and research on administrative cases involving people's livelihood, continuously summarize trial experience, promptly study and resolve problems encountered in work, accurately grasp the boundaries of law and policy, strictly control the factual, evidentiary, legal application, and trial procedure aspects of case handling, and ensure case quality. For new situations and new issues encountered in trial practice, timely countermeasures and suggestions shall be proposed to continuously improve the work level in adjudicating administrative cases involving people's livelihood. High People's Courts shall strengthen supervision and guidance over the adjudication of cases involving people's livelihood within their respective jurisdictions. New situations and issues concerning policies and legal application encountered in trial work shall be investigated and studied promptly, and reported to the Supreme People's Court when necessary. For defects and loopholes found in administrative law enforcement by administrative organs during trial activities, judicial suggestions shall be timely made to help them improve and perfect. Through public trials, public pronouncements of judgments, live broadcasts of court proceedings, and other forms, the social effect of trials shall be expanded, enhancing the people's understanding and trust in administrative trial work. The work situation of adjudicating administrative cases involving people's livelihood within each jurisdiction shall be fully grasped, and trial experience shall be summarized promptly. The Supreme People's Court will, at an appropriate time this year, select administrative cases concerning safeguarding people's livelihood that have typical significance and good effects for public release, and issue a special report and publicity on the adjudication and enforcement of administrative cases involving people's livelihood. Please have each High People's Court submit to the Supreme People's Court, before the end of June 2008, administrative cases involving people's livelihood adjudicated within their jurisdiction. Each High People's Court shall submit at least one case.

It is hereby notified.

March 25, 2008
